title: Galaxy Tab S4 (SM-T830)
description: Remote device management for Galaxy Tab S4 — battery status, device info, and shell commands via ADB.

tools.name: get-battery
tools.description: Get battery status of the Galaxy Tab S4
tools.command: adb -s ce031823cbe51cad0c7e shell dumpsys battery | grep level

tools.name: get-device-info
tools.description: Fetch basic device model and OS version
tools.command: adb -s ce031823cbe51cad0c7e shell getprop ro.product.model && adb -s ce031823cbe51cad0c7e shell getprop ro.build.version.release

tools.name: run-shell
tools.description: Execute arbitrary shell commands on the device
